{{Top|leg}}
The '''Twin Spears''' were located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rekkiad]]. They were a pair of columns of [[Water/Legends|ice]] several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall, with flat plateaus on top. Within [[First Spear|one]] of the two was the [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]], who fled to Rekkiad when his half-[[Brother/Legends|brother]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] [[Medriaas revolution|launched]] his campaign to conquer their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nathema|Medriaas]]. Later, a [[Unidentified Sith emissary|minion]] of Vitiate's came to Rekkiad with the help of [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], and came to the Twin Spears, where he discovered Dramath's tomb, and plundered his [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|crypt]].
